_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the 14 features, the rule engine, and feature normalization.
_do_not_edit_generated: Never hand-edit the generated files. Edit this spec and run tools/gen_engine.py, then tools/test_parity.py.

_feature_timing_contract.critical: ALL 14 features describe the state AFTER the current attempt has been scored, not before. This is what makes the rule engine's decision fully determined by the 14 features -- so the model can actually learn it.
_feature_timing_contract.correctness_is_derivable: There is deliberately no is_correct feature. current_streak > 0 means the attempt just scored was CORRECT; wrong_streak > 0 means it was WRONG. They are mutually exclusive and exactly one is > 0 after any scored attempt.
_feature_timing_contract.why_it_matters: If the rule engine branched on a variable the model never sees, the model could not reproduce the rule and accuracy would cap out for reasons that look like a training bug.

features.name: response_time
features.desc: Audio prompt end -> first key press. Clamped at max.

features.name: press_duration
features.desc: Mean press->release duration across the keys used in this attempt

features.name: retry_count
features.desc: Retries on THIS character within the current prompt

features.name: prev_accuracy
features.desc: Rolling accuracy on this character across all prior attempts

features.name: prev_mastery
features.desc: Mastery score for this character (see mastery_update)

features.name: hint_count
features.desc: Hints used on this character within the current prompt

features.name: time_since_last_practice
features.desc: Seconds since this character was last practiced. Clamped at 7 days.

features.name: prev_confidence
features.desc: Previous confidence state: 0 CONFIDENT, 1 HESITANT, 2 GUESSING

features.name: current_streak
features.desc: Consecutive CORRECT attempts on this character. >0 means the attempt just scored was correct.

features.name: wrong_streak
features.desc: Consecutive WRONG attempts on this character. >0 means the attempt just scored was wrong.

features.name: prev_mistakes
features.desc: Lifetime wrong attempts on this character, all sessions

_normalization_note: Fixed min-max scaling with clamping, using the min/max above. DELIBERATELY NOT dataset-derived: fixed ranges mean the ESP32's normalization can never drift from what the model was trained on, even when the dataset grows and the model is retrained. normalized = clamp((raw - min) / (max - min), 0, 1)
_rules_note: Ordered list, FIRST MATCH WINS. All conditions in a rule are ANDed unless logic is OR. The final rule must have an empty condition list (the default).

teaching_action_rules.rationale: Three wrong in a row on one character means the learner is stuck; go back rather than grind.
Struggling but no hint given yet.
Attempt was wrong (see correctness_is_derivable) but not yet stuck.
Character is solid; move to word-level use.
Weak character not seen for a day; refresh it.

confidence_rules.rationale: Many retries or a very long pause both read as guessing.

mastery_update._comment: Exponential moving average, applied AFTER each scored attempt. Shared by web, firmware, and the synthetic generator so mastery curves are identical everywhere.
mastery_update.formula: correct ? m + alpha_correct * (1 - m) : m - alpha_wrong * m

difficulty_update._comment: Applied after the teaching action is chosen.

session._comment: Definition of a session, so session_number and time_since_last_practice mean the same thing everywhere.
